decision.reason: The slot asks for 42 keycaps for a split ergonomic keyboard. The standard 1u Choc keycap is the general-purpose part and fits the bulk of the keys. The 1.5u, homing and thumb variants are specialty keycaps needed only in small numbers, so t

card.summary: SSD1306 OLED module, 0.91 inch, 128x32, I2C
Adafruit SSD1306 OLED 1.3 inch 128x64 I2C & SPI https://learn.adafruit.com/monochrome-oled-breakouts/downloads
OLED display 128x64

decision.reason: The 0.91 in 128x32 SSD1306 I2C OLED is the standard choice for wireless split keyboards (e.g. Corne, Lily58 with nice!view alternatives). It is small, draws the least power, which matters on battery over Bluetooth, and fits a compact half.

decision.reason: A wireless split keyboard needs one battery per half (quantity 2), and the usual choice is a small LiPo connected via a compact battery connector. The JST ACH 2-pin battery connector (marbastlib) is a battery-specific footprint for that use
